rag.title: Chat with your documents
rag.subtitle: Upload documents or paste text for AI to learn. Then ask questions and get answers based purely on your files.
rag.placeholder: Type your question about the document…
rag.speechNotSupported: Your browser does not support voice typing.
rag.indexedWithCategory: Document added. AI identified it as “{{category}}” and will use {{chunks}} chunks to answer.
rag.indexedSuccess: Document added. AI will use {{chunks}} chunks to answer your questions.
rag.indexedWithCategoryText: Text added. AI identified it as “{{category}}”.
rag.textIndexed: Text added. AI can now use this content to answer.
rag.conversationReset: Conversation restarted. Old messages are kept for context.
rag.resetError: Could not restart conversation. Try again.
rag.deleteError: Could not delete conversation. Try again.
rag.starter1: Summarize this document highlighting the main points.
rag.starter2: What are the most important conclusions or learnings?
rag.starter3: Extract vital concepts, entities, or rules from this text.
rag.addDocument: Add document for AI to learn
rag.dropOrClick: Drop files here or click to browse
rag.pasteTextPlaceholder: Paste the text you want the AI to use to answer your questions…
rag.customInstructionsHint: Write guidelines here for the AI to follow in all answers for this document. E.g., reply in bullet points, always cite the page, be more concise or detailed.
rag.customInstructionsPlaceholder: E.g., Prefer short answers. Always indicate the page number.
rag.indexFirst: Upload a file (PDF, TXT, MD, CSV, or JSON) above, or paste text into the 'Paste text' box. The AI will use the content to answer your questions.
rag.usingDocumentAll: Answering based on the entire Knowledge Base
rag.selectToChat: Select a document from the list to start chatting.
rag.restartConversation: Restart chat (history is kept for context)
rag.askDocument: Ask questions about the document. The AI answers strictly based on what is indexed.
rag.contextChunks: How many document chunks to fetch
rag.chunksUsed: more chunks = answer might use more context
rag.inputHint: Enter sends · Shift+Enter new line · Always verify the cited sources.
rag.noDocumentYet: There are no documents in the base yet. Go to the Documents tab, upload a file or paste text. Then come back to the Chat tab and select the document to start chatting.
rag.selectDocumentToUnlock: To send questions, select a document from the list (or Entire Knowledge Base). The question box is only enabled after you choose a document.
rag.hintNoDocs: No documents yet. Open the Documents tab, add a file or paste text, then come back here and select it to chat.
rag.hintSelectDoc: Select a document in the Documents tab (or Entire Knowledge Base) to enable sending questions.
rag.placeholderDisabled: Select a document in the Documents tab to enable…
rag.deleteDocument: Remove document from base and delete file
rag.deleteDocumentConfirm: Remove this document from the knowledge base and delete the file? This cannot be undone.
rag.documentDeleted: Document removed from the base and file deleted.
